tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ bya btang la nye bar mkhe ba'i yo byad kyi gsungs gling lags/ 368)sgom thag la sogs bya btang gi yo byad rnams kyi dri ba mdzad pa'i char spyi rgya gar du ni rab byung sbyang yon bcu gnyis land pa'i dge sbyong rnams ni bya btang gi yang rtse yin par snang yang 'o skol bod kyi dge sbyong tshe ni 'jig rten pa las kyang spros pa dang snang shas che ba 'di 'drar gyur tshe tha snyad ga la yod/ dra ba dang sgom thag ni dge slong ma yag gnas ba yin 'dug pa dang*/ dge slong gi sgom thag ni spus 'khyud ces bya ba mal nang du 'dug dus lus gnad mi zhig phyir spus mo la bcing bar 369)bshad pa tsam ma gtogs chag tshad nges pa ma gsungs/ dra ba yang dge sbyong dang rnor pa gnyis ka la dra ba zhes skud pa la bzos pa phyi nang zang thal du mthong ba de dgos pa ste/ zang zing gi dngos po rin chen thang can mi tshags pa'i dgos ched la dmigs shing*/ rdza khog dang phor pa phye rkyal tsam las gzhan mi bzung ba la dgongs pa yin phyir/ ding sang chos pa tshos 'khur ba'i ras dang rnam sleb sogs la bzos pa dang*/ de la yang ma brgyan dang dgu brgyan byas pa 'di ni 370)'jig ren snang shas kho na ma gtogs/ chos pa'i yo byad ma yin mod cing*/ 'di la ni ming yang dra phad ces bya ba/ 'jig rten phal pa rnams kyi sgye khug dang khyad med pas/ dra ba dngos kyi mtshan nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ de bzin du sgom thag kyang tshul ldan byed na dra mig can de dgos par gsungs pa ste/ rtsa dgu rkyang ro gsum mtshon pas gzhung skud gsum bshims/ dga' ba bcu drug mtshon pas dra mig bcu drug gtum mo'i me mtshon pa'i kha dog dmar po/ gsang yum rdo rje rnor ma mtshon phyir/ skye bo phal gyis mi mthong bar rang lus dang 'bral med bcang bar bshad pa'i dam tshig gi yo byad yin pa dang*/ chag tshad kyang*/ rje mi la yin gyi grub thob thams cad kyi lugs la/

nyis khug mgo bo la 'khor tsam de ka ( gcig rkyang mtho drug )yin yang*/ rje sgam po pa mi ma'i drung du thabs 371)lam bsgom pa'i skabs su dmyal ba thig nag gi bkod pa mthong zhing sku khams ma bde ba byung ba de la/ rje btsun gyis sgom thag thung ba'i skyon gyis rtsa 'thums par 'dug pas sgom thag ring du thong gsungs nas chang pa gang gis ring du btang ba'i rjes su 'brang nas/ ding sang ni mgo 'khor chang gang gi chag ( gcig rkyang mtho bdun )tshad yin la/ zheng ni sor bzhi'i gsum las ma bshad kyang*/ da lta'i chos gzugs zog mkhan tshos stod thams cad khebs pa dang*/ la las phor pa sogs bcug pa'i snod dang sbrag pa sogs/ gsang sngags 'chal ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs mu med byed mod/ gsang sngags rnying lugs la ni/ bai ro tsa na tsha ba rong nas bod du yar byon pa'i lam du/ gtsang rgan mi pham mgon po'am/ ming gi rnam grangs su/ spaṃ sangs rgyas mgon po zhes pa lo brgyad cu 372)lon pa'i dad can de la rdzogs pa chen po snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i gdams pa gnang skabs/ khong ha cang rgas pas lus gnad ma thub pas/ sgom thag dang sgom mkhar la brten te bsgom du bcug pas/ phung po 'ja' lus grub pa byung*/ de'i rten 'brel dang byin rlabs la dmigs nas/ da lta yang chos bka' de'i dbang gi skabs su/ dbang rdzas la sgom thag dang*/ sgom mthar ram sgom shing gis nges la rdo rje zam pa'i rtsa tshig yi ger bris pa dang bcas pas dbu mar ba'i phyag bzhes mdzad pa lags/ sgom skyed ni gang zag chos 'phral bzos ma gtogs gzhung nas bshad pa ma mthong*/ 'brug lugs la ni/ gtsang pa rgya ras nas rgyal dbang rje'i bar gyi phyag bzhes la bya chas bzhi zhes/ sgom zhwa/ sgom thag dra ba mi mang*/ gnyer po dung chos 373)zhes pa/ khams byang sems mi nyams pa'i dran rten du rdog cig skud pa dmar po la brgyus te srin lag g.yon la bcings shing sbed pa ste/

bya chas bzhi/ rang shong gi cog pu/ dam tshig dang mthun pa'i phreng ba dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid dgos ched phan yon sogs nas gsungs so/ rkang gling ni/ spyir rab byung dang bya btang sha srag la dgos pa mi yong mod kyang*/ gsang sngags pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas kyi bye brag yin mod kya/ rgya gar du rab byung rnams sbyin bdag gi sgo drung du bsod snyoms slong ba'i brda 'khar sil gyi sgra 'khrol zhing*/ rnal 'byor sa yin na ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba'am/ khri gnyan ra dung 'bud pa yin mod tshe/ rkang gling dus min du 'dabud kyang mi rung ba yin snang la/ bod khrims med gdol pa'i yul du song tshe nges pa ma mchis mod/ gsang sngags khyad par 374)ba'i skabs don la ni/ cho ga sogs kyi dus na/ rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyan drangs ba thugs dam bskang ba/ phrin las bskul ba sogs dgos ched mang ba dang*/ de dag kyang rang rang gi skabs ma nal babs tshe/ ting 'dzin rtags mthun du 'bud cing*/ dus min skabs min dang rtsed mo'i zhor la 'bud pa sogs mi bya ba dang*/ gcod kyi skabs sogs la ni/ rkang dung gi mtshan nyid spang blang sogs zhib par lab sgron gyi gcod gzhung chen mor 'byung ba ltar dang*/ gnas skabs rgyun gyi thun tshod 'dzin pa sogs 'di dag la'ang*/ 'bud lugs kyi skad 'gyur tshad ldan dgos phyir ding sang bka' rgyud pa rnams kyi dgu 'bud zer ba 'di ni/ bde mchog gi rtsa sngags yi ge bdun pa nyid brda skad yin par gsungs te/ de yang yi ge bdun pa la oṃ gcig las med kyang skabs 375)'dir phag mo'i oṃ gsum ma dang bstun pa'i skad brda bya ba yin pas/ thog mar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ zhes 'thung ba gsum 'bud/ de nas hrīḥ zhes rgyang ring ba gcig de nas ha zhes ring ba cig de nas ha gcig gcig gcig= gcig= zhes rgyang ring zhing ldem 'gyur yod pa gcig de nas hūm̐/ hūm̐/ zhes thung na gnyis/ de rjes/

phaṭa' 'di cung zad ring ba tsam byas pa ste/ de ltar dgu la/ dgu 'bud zer ba ste ding sang dkar 'brug tshos byed pa de ka yin/ ༈ 'o skol rnying lugs la/ sngon tshe kham ka thog gi grub thob dam gtsang byams gsum sogs kyis zhal bkod kyi rgyun la rkang dung bdun 'bud 'di bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa'i skad brda yin te/ thog mar/ mchod/ mchod/ ces pa gnyis 'di'i snga ma ring tsam dang rjes la thung bar bya/ de nas 376)bla ma/ bla ma/ zhes bla ma 'bod pa 'di gnyis ka rgyang ring por bya/ de nas/ bla ma mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes pa rgyang ring zhing ldem 'gyur dang bcas pa bya/ de rjes/ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ ces pa gnyis 'di'i snga ma cung zad ring tsam dang*/ phyi ma mthung rbad kyi bcad nas bzhag pa yin la/ bla ma 'bod pa'i rgyang gsum po de lag mgo la skad shag che ba la mjug tu rim pas chung nar gyi bzhag pa ni bla ma dran pa'i mos gus gdung shugs skyo phyir yin zhing*/ skad brda 'di 'bud lugs mkhas pa cig byung na snang ba 'gyur te skyo lhang gi gtong thub pa yod/ de ltar rkang dung la yang skad brda tshad ldan dgos par gsungs pa lags spyir/ sgrub grwa tsho la thun bzhi nges can byed pa 'di ni/ 'di tsho rkyag re chung ba ma gtogs/ dge sbyor sgrig ma tshul ldan byed mkhan ni/ tho rangs kyi 'di 377)bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi thun/ nyi ma shar ba na chu gtor gyi thun/ phyi dro 'di gtor bsngos thun/ srod kyi 'di gcod kyi thun yin tshe/ thun dung 'di rnams dang bstun pa'i dge sbyor de dag sgrigs chags su byed dgos par brda yin par 'dug mod kyi/ tshul bzhin byed mkhan mi rnyed kyang go rtogs de bzhin 'jags par bya'o// 378)
